thing-type.label: Hisense TV
thing-type.description: A Hisense television with a RemoteNOW MQTT service.

parameter.name: host
parameter.label: Host
parameter.description: The hostname or IP address of the TV.

parameter.name: port
parameter.label: MQTT Port
parameter.description: The port of the MQTT broker on the TV.

parameter.name: tls
parameter.label: Use TLS
parameter.description: Use TLS to connect to the TV's MQTT broker.

parameter.name: certificateFingerprint
parameter.label: Certificate Fingerprint
parameter.description: The SHA-256 fingerprint of the TV certificate, with optional colon separators. Set this for a self-signed certificate.

parameter.name: username
parameter.label: MQTT Username
parameter.description: Overrides the TV's standard MQTT username.

parameter.name: password
parameter.label: MQTT Password
parameter.description: Overrides the TV's standard MQTT password.

parameter.name: remoteId
parameter.label: Remote ID
parameter.description: Remote app identity used for pairing. The default matches newAM/hisensetv.

parameter.name: refreshInterval
parameter.label: Refresh Interval
parameter.description: Interval for polling the volume in seconds.

channel-type.label: Remote Key
channel-type.description: Sends a remote control key such as KEY_POWER, KEY_HOME or KEY_OK.

channel-type.label: Volume
channel-type.description: The volume level of the TV.

channel-type.label: Select Input
channel-type.description: Selects a TV input by its source ID.

channel-type.label: Available Inputs
channel-type.description: The list of TV inputs as JSON.
